name: Trofeo Laigueglia
story: Louis Vervaeke attacked solo from an early breakaway of ten riders. A counterattack featuring Santiago Buitrago, Antonio Tiberi, Romain Grégoire, and Quinten Hermans bridged across, catching him in the second local lap. Hermans and Vervaeke were dropped before Buitrago attacked on the final ascent of Colla Micheri to win solo, ahead of Grégoire and Tiberi.
